subject: Weekly football for the companies at WTC Amsterdam
body:
Hi Rik,

I saw the WTC Amsterdam Socialclub already runs padel clinics and sports activities for everyone in the building.

I'm Brian from FC Urban. We organise social football games across the Netherlands, and we already run games at Rooftop Zuidas (https://www.fcurban.com/location/rooftop-zuidas), about a 13 minute walk from WTC Amsterdam.

We'd love to help you set up a weekly after work game, or a small league between the companies at WTC Amsterdam. We handle the pitch, the organisation and the payments, so it's no extra work for your team, and if a few people can't make it we fill the spare places with our own players.

Would you be open to a quick chat?

Best,
Brian
FC Urban

Reply with "no thanks" and I won't contact you again.
